data.content:
Automated Literature Review Using NLP Techniques and LLM-Based Retrieval-Augmented Generation
The research paper explores how to automate the process of generating literature reviews using NLP techniques and a large language model.

Large Language Model GPT-3.5-turbo
GPT-3.5-turbo is a type of large language model utilized in this research for automatic generation of literature reviews.

Simple T5
The transformer-based model Simple T5 is used as one of the NLP strategies to generate literature reviews.

spaCy
spaCy is a natural language processing strategy used for automatic generation of literature reviews based on frequency.

SciTLDR dataset
The SciTLDR dataset is used as the basis for this research work on automated literature review generation.

ROUGE scores
The Simple T5 transformer model obtained a lower ROUGE score compared to other evaluated NLP strategies in this research.

DAiD
DAiD is a training-free plug-and-use decoding strategy that directly merges the distribution of model-predicted patches with the distribution of retrieved patches in AR-RAG.

ROUGE-1 score evaluation
The Simple T5 model was evaluated based on its ROUGE-1 score performance.

FAiD
FAiD is a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method that progressively smooths the features of retrieved patches via multi-scale convolution operations and leverages them to augment the image generation process in AR-RAG.

Image Generation
AR-RAG is designed for enhancing image generation tasks by incorporating autoregressive retrievals at the patch level.

EVOR
EVOR is a novel pipeline for retrieval-augmented code generation (RACG) that employs the synchronous evolution of both queries and diverse knowledge bases.

Faithfulness and Relevance Metrics

Large Models

GraphRAG
GraphRAG is a new approach combining knowledge graphs with retrieval-augmented generation.

Community Detection Algorithms
